ops.title: EnsureToken race-safe convergence via exclusive link
ops.body:
Concurrent first-run `EnsureToken` calls (multiple CLI invocations, daemon boot racing `pair`) must all return the single token that landed on disk — never each their own mint, or a pairing QR can carry a token the daemon never persisted.

Invariant and mechanism:

- Mint into a same-dir temp file (content fully written and closed first), then publish with `os.Link(tmp, TokenPath())`. Link is filesystem-atomic and fails with `fs.ErrExist` when a token already exists: first writer wins, losers `ReadToken()` the winner's value and return that.
- `ResetToken` intentionally overwrites — it publishes via `os.Rename` (atomic replace), so a concurrent reader never observes a partially-written token.
- Direct `os.WriteFile` or in-process mutexes cannot provide this: the race is cross-process, and last-write-wins silently splits what callers hold from what's on disk.

Regression test: `TestEnsureTokenConcurrentFirstRun` (access/access_test.go) races 8 mints and asserts all returned tokens equal the on-disk one and no `.token-*` temp files leak.
ops.when: before modifying EnsureToken or token persistence
